description: This file defines classes and enums related to AES encryption and decryption in the WPEFramework Crypto namespace. It includes declarations for the AESEncryption and AESDecryption classes, their methods, and associated enum types for encryption modes and key lengths.

classes.name: AESEncryption
classes.description: Class responsible for AES encryption operations, managing encryption mode, initialization vector, and encryption key.

classes.name: AESDecryption
classes.description: Class responsible for AES decryption operations, managing decryption mode, initialization vector, and decryption key.

methods.name: InitialVector
methods.description: Gets or sets the initialization vector used for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the encryption/decryption key with specified length.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on input data.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on input data.
